premise: Bear cub cannot fall asleep, so Owl shows him how: blink, look around, yawn, eyes shut. Bear cub copies him while Firefly holds up her light, and nods off.
inspiration: The folk bedtime ritual, where each step of settling down is named in turn; turned so the helper shows instead of tells, and the child listening can copy too.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Cannot Sleep
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7 60s} {sfx:night-bed} [softly] The moon was up, and the forest was {all:face sleeping} fast asleep. Everyone except little {bear:enter} Bear cub, toddling out of his den. {bear:wobble x2} He wriggled. He wiggled. {bear:face sad} [sad] I can't fall asleep, he said. I don't know how! {owl:enter} Owl flew down onto a branch, wide awake, as owls are at night. {owl:face happy} [whispers] I'll show you. Watch me. {owl:live} He blinked. He looked around. He gave a big yawn… and fell asleep. He opened one eye… then both, and hooted softly. {sfx:hoo} Hoo-hoo. {bear:face happy} {bear:shake 0.4} [giggles] Bear cub giggled. {firefly:enter} Firefly came drifting by. {firefly:face happy} I'll hold the light. {firefly:live hold} She closed her eyes, and her tail glowed brighter and brighter, like a little lantern. [slowly] So Bear cub {bear:live hold} gave a great big yawn. He stretched his arms up high. He rubbed his eyes… and nodded off, sitting up. {owl:hearts} [whispers] Goodnight, Bear cub, said Owl. {firefly:live resume} And Firefly let her light go dim… and blinked it twice.

es-ES.title: El osito no se puede dormir
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7 60s} {sfx:night-bed} [softly] La luna ya había salido y el bosque {all:face sleeping} dormía profundamente. Todos menos el pequeño {bear:enter} Osito, que salió caminando de su cueva. {bear:wobble x2} Se revolvía. Se retorcía. {bear:face sad} [sad] No me puedo dormir, dijo. ¡No sé cómo se hace! {owl:enter} Búho bajó volando hasta una rama, bien despierto, como los búhos por la noche. {owl:face happy} [whispers] Yo te enseño. Mírame. {owl:live} Parpadeó. Miró a su alrededor. Dio un gran bostezo… y se durmió. Luego abrió un ojo… después los dos, y ululó bajito. {sfx:hoo} Uh-uh. {bear:face happy} {bear:shake 0.4} [giggles] Osito se rio. {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga pasaba volando. {firefly:face happy} Yo os doy luz. {firefly:live hold} Cerró los ojos, y su colita brilló más y más, como un farolillo. [slowly] Así que Osito {bear:live hold} dio un bostezo enorme. Estiró los brazos bien alto. Se frotó los ojos… y se quedó dormido, sentadito. {owl:hearts} [whispers] Buenas noches, Osito, dijo Búho. {firefly:live resume} Y Luciérnaga fue apagando su luz… y parpadeó dos veces.

night-bed.prompt: a calm summer night in the woods, soft distant crickets and a light breeze

hoo.prompt: a soft friendly owl hoot, two gentle notes, calm and warm
